# Getting help
There are two ways to ask for help in game. Mentor Help is for questions about how the game works. The Admin Help is for Staff: reports about other players, rule questions, bugs and getting stuck in a wall.
## Mentor Help
Press Shift+F1 or the Mentor Help button, pick a topic and ask your question. A Mentor claims your question and answers in the same window. Mentors show only as Mentor, and they see only your character's name. When you're done, you can rate the answer. If a Mentor behaves badly, use Report this Mentor.
## When to ask Staff
Use the Admin Help for anything about rules or other players, for bugs, or when you're stuck and need something done. Mentors can escalate your question to Staff if they think it needs it.
